name: Spooky Investigator
source:
You take on the role of a student investigator who must take a remedial test in order to graduate from the highly regarded Spooxford University, a center of learning for all manner of magically inclined beings. 

Made during the Search for the Truth Jam. 

Some elements of this game are still unfinished. Please keep that in mind while playing and thanks for checking it out! There is no penalty system, so feel free to try out all choices during the presentation phase to see all the dialogue.

[From [url=https://arodude.itch.io/spooky-investigator] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名学生调查员，为了从备受推崇的斯普克斯福德大学毕业，必须参加补考。这所大学是所有魔法生物学习知识的中心。

本作在“寻找真相”游戏创作活动中制作。

游戏仍有部分内容尚未完成，请在游玩时注意，并感谢试玩！本作没有惩罚系统，因此可以在演示阶段尝试所有选项，查看全部对话。

（来源：[url=https://arodude.itch.io/spooky-investigator]itch.io[/url]）
